    "FUNCTION Z_CODEX_MCP_SCI_API.",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"本地接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_ACTION) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_STATUS) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_ENGINE) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_VERSION) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SCOPE) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_VARIANT) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COUNT) TYPE  INT4",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      ET_RESULTS STRUCTURE  BAPIRET2",
    "*\"----------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "",
    "  DATA lo_variant TYPE REF TO cl_ci_checkvariant.",
    "  DATA lo_objects TYPE REF TO cl_ci_objectset.",
    "  DATA lo_inspect TYPE REF TO cl_ci_inspection.",
    "  DATA lo_tests TYPE REF TO cl_ci_tests.",
    "  DATA lo_syntax TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_syntax_check.",
    "  DATA lo_critical TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_critical_statements.",
    "  DATA lo_test TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_root.",
    "  DATA lt_variant TYPE sci_tstvar.",
    "  DATA lt_tests TYPE sci_tabtest.",
    "  DATA lt_objects TYPE scit_objs.",
    "  DATA ls_object TYPE scir_objs.",
    "  DATA ls_finding TYPE scir_rest.",
    "  DATA lv_text TYPE string.",
    "  DATA lv_count TYPE i.",
    "  DATA ls_rule TYPE sci_tstval.",
    "  DATA ls_message TYPE bapiret2.",
    "  CLEAR: ev_status, ev_code, ev_count.",
    "  REFRESH et_results.",
    "  ev_engine = 'SCI'.",
    "  ev_version = '1.0'.",
    "  ev_scope = 'ZCODEX_MCP_CORE'.",
    "  ev_variant = 'DEFAULT'.",
    "  ev_status = 'E'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INVALID_ACTION'.",
    "  IF iv_action <> 'PRECHECK' AND iv_action <> 'RUN'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_DEVELOP'",
    "    ID 'DEVCLASS' FIELD 'ZABAP'",
    "    ID 'OBJTYPE' FIELD 'FUGR'",
    "    ID 'OBJNAME' FIELD 'ZCODEX_MCP_CORE'",
    "    ID 'P_GROUP' DUMMY",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'NOT_AUTHORIZED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  TRY.",
    "      IF iv_action = 'RUN'.",
    "        ev_variant = 'SYNTAX_CRITICAL_V1'.",
    "        ev_code = 'RULE_VERSION_MISMATCH'.",
    "        CREATE OBJECT lo_syntax.",
    "        CREATE OBJECT lo_critical.",
    "        IF lo_syntax->version <> '001' OR",
    "           lo_critical->version <> '002'.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        CLEAR ls_rule.",
    "        ls_rule-testname = 'CL_CI_TEST_SYNTAX_CHECK'.",
    "        ls_rule-version = lo_syntax->version.",
    "        INSERT ls_rule INTO TABLE lt_variant.",
    "        ls_rule-testname = 'CL_CI_TEST_CRITICAL_STATEMENTS'.",
    "        ls_rule-version = lo_critical->version.",
    "        INSERT ls_rule INTO TABLE lt_variant.",
    "        ev_code = 'RULE_LOAD_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD cl_ci_tests=>get_list",
    "          EXPORTING p_variant = lt_variant",
    "          RECEIVING p_result = lo_tests",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_tests IS INITIAL.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        lt_tests = lo_tests->give_list( ).",
    "        DESCRIBE TABLE lt_tests LINES lv_count.",
    "        IF lv_count <> 2.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        LOOP AT lt_tests INTO lo_test.",
    "          IF '1PRG' NOT IN lo_test->typelist AND",
    "             'FUGR' NOT IN lo_test->typelist.",
    "            ev_code = 'RULE_NOT_APPLICABLE'.",
    "            RETURN.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        ev_code = 'VARIANT_CREATE_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD cl_ci_checkvariant=>create",
    "          EXPORTING p_user = sy-uname p_name = space",
    "          RECEIVING p_ref = lo_variant",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_variant IS INITIAL.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        CALL METHOD lo_variant->set_variant",
    "          EXPORTING p_variant = lt_variant",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ls_object-objtype = 'FUGR'.",
    "        ls_object-objname = 'ZCODEX_MCP_CORE'.",
    "        APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "        ev_code = 'OBJECTSET_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD cl_ci_objectset=>save_from_list",
    "          EXPORTING p_user = sy-uname p_objects = lt_objects",
    "          RECEIVING p_ref = lo_objects",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_objects IS INITIAL.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        DESCRIBE TABLE lo_objects->iobjlst-objects",
    "          LINES lv_count.",
    "        IF lv_count <> 1.",
    "          ev_code = 'OBJECTSET_NOT_EXACT'.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        READ TABLE lo_objects->iobjlst-objects",
    "          INDEX 1 INTO ls_object.",
    "        IF ls_object-objtype <> 'FUGR' OR",
    "           ls_object-objname <> 'ZCODEX_MCP_CORE' OR",
    "           ls_object-prgname IS INITIAL.",
    "          ev_code = 'OBJECTSET_NOT_EXACT'.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_code = 'INSPECTION_CREATE_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD cl_ci_inspection=>create",
    "          EXPORTING p_user = sy-uname p_name = space",
    "          RECEIVING p_ref = lo_inspect",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_inspect IS INITIAL.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_code = 'INSPECTION_SET_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD lo_inspect->set",
    "          EXPORTING p_chkv = lo_variant p_objs = lo_objects",
    "            p_noaunit = 'X' p_nosuppress = 'X'",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        ev_code = 'SCI_RUN_FAILED'.",
    "        CALL METHOD lo_inspect->run",
    "          EXPORTING p_howtorun = 'D'",
    "          EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "        IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        DESCRIBE TABLE lo_inspect->sciresthd LINES lv_count.",
    "        IF lv_count <> 1.",
    "          ev_code = 'RESULT_COVERAGE_UNKNOWN'.",
    "          RETURN.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        DESCRIBE TABLE lo_inspect->scirestps LINES ev_count.",
    "        LOOP AT lo_inspect->scirestps INTO ls_finding",
    "          FROM 1 TO 1000.",
    "          CLEAR: ls_message, lv_text.",
    "          ls_message-type = ls_finding-kind.",
    "          ls_message-message_v1 = ls_finding-test.",
    "          ls_message-message_v2 = ls_finding-code.",
    "          ls_message-message_v3 = ls_finding-sobjname.",
    "          ls_message-message_v4 = ls_finding-col.",
    "          CONDENSE ls_message-message_v4.",
    "          ls_message-row = ls_finding-line.",
    "          IF ls_finding-test = 'CL_CI_TEST_SYNTAX_CHECK'.",
    "            lv_text = ls_finding-param1.",
    "          ELSEIF ls_finding-test =",
    "            'CL_CI_TEST_CRITICAL_STATEMENTS'.",
    "            CALL METHOD lo_critical->get_message_text",
    "              EXPORTING p_test = ls_finding-test",
    "                p_code = ls_finding-code",
    "              IMPORTING p_text = lv_text.",
    "            REPLACE ALL OCCURRENCES OF '&1' IN lv_text",
    "              WITH ls_finding-param1.",
    "          ELSE.",
    "            CONCATENATE ls_finding-test ls_finding-code",
    "              ls_finding-param1 INTO lv_text",
    "              SEPARATED BY space.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          ls_message-message = lv_text.",
    "          IF strlen( lv_text ) > 220.",
    "            ls_message-field = 'TEXT_TRUNCATED'.",
    "          ENDIF.",
    "          APPEND ls_message TO et_results.",
    "        ENDLOOP.",
    "        ev_status = 'W'.",
    "        ev_code = 'FINDINGS_LIMITED'.",
    "        IF ev_count = 0.",
    "          ev_code = 'NO_FINDINGS_UNVERIFIED'.",
    "        ELSEIF ev_count > 1000.",
    "          ev_code = 'TRUNCATED_LIMITED'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'VARIANT_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "      CALL METHOD cl_ci_checkvariant=>get_ref",
    "        EXPORTING",
    "          p_user = space",
    "          p_name = 'DEFAULT'",
    "          p_dont_look_for_new_chkv = 'X'",
    "        RECEIVING p_ref = lo_variant",
    "        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_variant IS INITIAL.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'VARIANT_READ_FAILED'.",
    "      CALL METHOD lo_variant->get_info",
    "        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'EMPTY_VARIANT'.",
    "      IF lo_variant->variant IS INITIAL.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      LOOP AT lo_variant->variant INTO ls_rule.",
    "        CLEAR ls_message.",
    "        ls_message-type = 'I'.",
    "        ls_message-message_v1 = ls_rule-testname.",
    "        ls_message-number = ls_rule-version.",
    "        ls_message-message = 'Configured SCI rule; not executed'.",
    "        IF ls_rule-attributes IS NOT INITIAL.",
    "          ls_message-message_v2 = 'HAS_ATTRIBUTES'.",
    "        ENDIF.",
    "        APPEND ls_message TO et_results.",
    "      ENDLOOP.",
    "      SORT et_results BY message_v1.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE et_results LINES ev_count.",
    "      ev_status = 'S'.",
    "      ev_code = 'PREFLIGHT_ONLY'.",
    "    CATCH cx_root.",
    "      ev_status = 'E'.",
    "      \" Preserve the failed stage for the caller.",
    "  ENDTRY.",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "",
    "ENDFUNCTION."
  ],

    "FUNCTION Z_CODEX_MCP_SCI_V2.",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "*\"*\"局部接口：",
    "*\"  IMPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_ACTION) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OBJECT_TYPE) TYPE  TROBJTYPE",
    "*\"     VALUE(IV_OBJECT_NAME) TYPE  SOBJ_NAME",
    "*\"  EXPORTING",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_STATUS) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CODE) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_ENGINE) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_VERSION) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_VARIANT) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_COUNT) TYPE  INT4",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJTYPE) TYPE  TROBJTYPE",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_OBJNAME) TYPE  SOBJ_NAME",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_PROGRAM) TYPE  PROGRAMM",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_PACKAGE) TYPE  DEVCLASS",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_SYNTAX) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"     VALUE(EV_CRITICAL) TYPE  CHAR50",
    "*\"  TABLES",
    "*\"      ET_RESULTS STRUCTURE  BAPIRET2",
    "*\"--------------------------------------------------------------------",
    "DATA lo_variant TYPE REF TO cl_ci_checkvariant.",
    "  DATA lo_objects TYPE REF TO cl_ci_objectset.",
    "  DATA lo_inspect TYPE REF TO cl_ci_inspection.",
    "  DATA lo_tests TYPE REF TO cl_ci_tests.",
    "  DATA lo_syntax TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_syntax_check.",
    "  DATA lo_critical TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_critical_statements.",
    "  DATA lo_test TYPE REF TO cl_ci_test_root.",
    "  DATA lt_variant TYPE sci_tstvar.",
    "  DATA lt_tests TYPE sci_tabtest.",
    "  DATA lt_objects TYPE scit_objs.",
    "  DATA ls_object TYPE scir_objs.",
    "  DATA ls_finding TYPE scir_rest.",
    "  DATA ls_rule TYPE sci_tstval.",
    "  DATA ls_message TYPE bapiret2.",
    "  DATA lv_text TYPE string.",
    "  DATA lv_count TYPE i.",
    "  DATA lv_package TYPE tadir-devclass.",
    "  DATA lv_subc TYPE trdir-subc.",
    "  CLEAR: ev_status, ev_code, ev_count, ev_objtype, ev_objname,",
    "    ev_program, ev_package, ev_syntax, ev_critical.",
    "  REFRESH et_results.",
    "  ev_engine = 'SCI'.",
    "  ev_version = '2.0'.",
    "  ev_variant = 'SYNTAX_CRITICAL_V1'.",
    "  ev_status = 'E'.",
    "  ev_code = 'INVALID_ACTION'.",
    "  IF iv_action <> 'PRECHECK' AND iv_action <> 'RUN'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  ev_code = 'INVALID_TARGET'.",
    "  IF iv_object_type <> 'PROG' AND iv_object_type <> 'CLAS'",
    "     AND iv_object_type <> 'FUGR'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF iv_object_name IS INITIAL OR",
    "     ( iv_object_name(1) <> 'Z' AND iv_object_name(1) <> 'Y' ).",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  lv_text = iv_object_name.",
    "  IF lv_text CN 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789_'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF iv_object_type <> 'PROG' AND strlen( lv_text ) > 30.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  ev_code = 'OBJECT_NOT_FOUND'.",
    "  SELECT SINGLE devclass INTO lv_package FROM tadir",
    "    WHERE pgmid = 'R3TR' AND object = iv_object_type",
    "      AND obj_name = iv_object_name AND delflag = space.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lv_package IS INITIAL.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_DEVELOP'",
    "    ID 'DEVCLASS' FIELD lv_package",
    "    ID 'OBJTYPE' FIELD iv_object_type",
    "    ID 'OBJNAME' FIELD iv_object_name",
    "    ID 'P_GROUP' DUMMY",
    "    ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'.",
    "  IF sy-subrc <> 0.",
    "    ev_code = 'NOT_AUTHORIZED'.",
    "    RETURN.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  IF iv_object_type = 'PROG'.",
    "    ev_code = 'NOT_MAIN_PROGRAM'.",
    "    SELECT SINGLE subc INTO lv_subc FROM trdir",
    "      WHERE name = iv_object_name.",
    "    IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR",
    "       ( lv_subc <> '1' AND lv_subc <> 'M' AND lv_subc <> 'S' ).",
    "      RETURN.",
    "    ENDIF.",
    "  ENDIF.",
    "  TRY.",
    "      ls_object-objtype = iv_object_type.",
    "      ls_object-objname = iv_object_name.",
    "      APPEND ls_object TO lt_objects.",
    "      ev_code = 'OBJECTSET_FAILED'.",
    "      CALL METHOD cl_ci_objectset=>save_from_list",
    "        EXPORTING p_user = sy-uname p_objects = lt_objects",
    "          p_name = space",
    "        RECEIVING p_ref = lo_objects",
    "        EXCEPTIONS OTHERS = 1.",
    "      IF sy-subrc <> 0 OR lo_objects IS INITIAL.",
    "        RETURN.",
    "      ENDIF.",
    "      ev_code = 'OBJECTSET_NOT_EXACT'.",
    "      DESCRIBE TABLE lo_objects->iobjlst-objects LINES lv_count.",
    "      IF lv_count <> 1.",

        iv_object_name TYPE sobj_name
      EXPORTING

        ev_code        TYPE sy-msgv1
        ev_message     TYPE bapi_msg
        ev_version     TYPE sy-msgv1.

  PRIVATE SECTION.
    CLASS-METHODS validate_target
      IMPORTING

        iv_object_name TYPE sobj_name
      EXPORTING
        ev_code        TYPE sy-msgv1
        ev_message     TYPE bapi_msg.
ENDCLASS.


CLASS zcl_codex_mcp_core IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA lv_operation TYPE rs38l-name.
    DATA lv_code TYPE sy-msgv1.
    DATA lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.

    CLEAR: ev_status, ev_code, ev_message.
    ev_version = c_version.

    lv_operation = iv_operation.
    TRANSLATE lv_operation TO UPPER CASE.
    CONDENSE lv_operation NO-GAPS.

    CASE lv_operation.
      WHEN 'PING'.
        ev_status = 'S'.
        ev_code = 'READY'.
        ev_message = 'Codex MCP SAP helper is ready'.

      WHEN 'VALIDATE_TARGET'.
        validate_target(
          EXPORTING
            iv_object_type = iv_object_type
            iv_object_name = iv_object_name
          IMPORTING
            ev_code = lv_code
            ev_message = lv_message ).
        IF lv_code IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'S'.
          ev_code = 'TARGET_ALLOWED'.
          ev_message = 'Customer object target is allowed'.
        ELSE.
          ev_status = 'E'.
          ev_code = lv_code.
          ev_message = lv_message.
        ENDIF.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        ev_status = 'E'.
        ev_code = 'OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED'.
        ev_message = 'The requested operation is not allowed'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD validate_target.
    DATA lv_object_type TYPE trobjtype.
    DATA lv_object_name TYPE sobj_name.

    CLEAR: ev_code, ev_message.
    lv_object_type = iv_object_type.
    lv_object_name = iv_object_name.
    TRANSLATE: lv_object_type TO UPPER CASE,
               lv_object_name TO UPPER CASE.
    CONDENSE: lv_object_type NO-GAPS,
              lv_object_name NO-GAPS.

    IF lv_object_name IS INITIAL
       OR ( lv_object_name(1) <> 'Z'
            AND lv_object_name(1) <> 'Y' ).
      ev_code = 'CUSTOMER_OBJECT_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Only Z* or Y* customer objects are allowed'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'CLAS' OR 'INTF' OR 'PROG' OR 'FUGR' OR 'FUNC'
        OR 'TABL' OR 'DTEL' OR 'DOMA' OR 'TTYP' OR 'MSAG'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED'.
        ev_message = 'The requested object type is not allowed'.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_DEVELOP'
      ID 'DEVCLASS' DUMMY
      ID 'OBJTYPE' FIELD lv_object_type
      ID 'OBJNAME' FIELD lv_object_name
      ID 'P_GROUP' DUMMY
      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ev_code = 'NOT_AUTHORIZED'.
      ev_message = 'SAP user is not authorized for this object'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_codex_mcp_core IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA lv_operation TYPE rs38l-name.
    DATA lv_code TYPE sy-msgv1.
    DATA lv_message TYPE bapi_msg.

    CLEAR: ev_status, ev_code, ev_message.
    ev_version = c_version.

    lv_operation = iv_operation.
    TRANSLATE lv_operation TO UPPER CASE.
    CONDENSE lv_operation NO-GAPS.

    CASE lv_operation.
      WHEN 'PING'.
        ev_status = 'S'.
        ev_code = 'READY'.
        ev_message = 'Codex MCP SAP helper is ready'.

      WHEN 'VALIDATE_TARGET'.
        validate_target(
          EXPORTING
            iv_object_type = iv_object_type
            iv_object_name = iv_object_name
          IMPORTING
            ev_code = lv_code
            ev_message = lv_message ).
        IF lv_code IS INITIAL.
          ev_status = 'S'.
          ev_code = 'TARGET_ALLOWED'.
          ev_message = 'Customer object target is allowed'.
        ELSE.
          ev_status = 'E'.
          ev_code = lv_code.
          ev_message = lv_message.
        ENDIF.

      WHEN OTHERS.
        ev_status = 'E'.
        ev_code = 'OPERATION_NOT_ALLOWED'.
        ev_message = 'The requested operation is not allowed'.
    ENDCASE.
  ENDMETHOD.


  METHOD validate_target.
    DATA lv_object_type TYPE trobjtype.
    DATA lv_object_name TYPE sobj_name.

    CLEAR: ev_code, ev_message.
    lv_object_type = iv_object_type.
    lv_object_name = iv_object_name.
    TRANSLATE: lv_object_type TO UPPER CASE,
               lv_object_name TO UPPER CASE.
    CONDENSE: lv_object_type NO-GAPS,
              lv_object_name NO-GAPS.

    IF lv_object_name IS INITIAL
       OR ( lv_object_name(1) <> 'Z'
            AND lv_object_name(1) <> 'Y' ).
      ev_code = 'CUSTOMER_OBJECT_REQUIRED'.
      ev_message = 'Only Z* or Y* customer objects are allowed'.
      RETURN.
    ENDIF.

    CASE lv_object_type.
      WHEN 'CLAS' OR 'INTF' OR 'PROG' OR 'FUGR' OR 'FUNC'
        OR 'TABL' OR 'DTEL' OR 'DOMA' OR 'TTYP' OR 'MSAG'.
      WHEN OTHERS.
        ev_code = 'OBJECT_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED'.
        ev_message = 'The requested object type is not allowed'.
        RETURN.
    ENDCASE.

    AUTHORITY-CHECK OBJECT 'S_DEVELOP'
      ID 'DEVCLASS' DUMMY
      ID 'OBJTYPE' FIELD lv_object_type
      ID 'OBJNAME' FIELD lv_object_name
      ID 'P_GROUP' DUMMY
      ID 'ACTVT' FIELD '03'.
    IF sy-subrc <> 0.
      ev_code = 'NOT_AUTHORIZED'.
      ev_message = 'SAP user is not authorized for this object'.
    ENDIF.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
